module_dispositions.rationale: Defines the shared if_test and fi_or_else command classes exercised by conditional dispatch.
Defines frozen_fi among the permanent eqtb identities; its executable recovery use is classified in §§336 and 493–510.
Owns outer-validity recovery when skipped conditional text reaches EOF or an outer token.
Enumerates the general expandable-command interval; §367 supplies the independently executable conditional dispatch.
Dispatches if_test to conditional and fi_or_else to delimiter processing from the expansion loop.
Defines and registers all seventeen TeX82 conditional predicate operands.
Provides print_cmd_chr spellings for predicate command codes already classified by §487.
Defines the independent condition stack, current limit, kind, and source-line state.
Initializes the empty condition-stack representation defined by §489.
Registers fi, or, and else in the shared fi_or_else command class and freezes fi for recovery.
Provides print_cmd_chr spellings for delimiter command codes already classified by §491.
Defines pass_text scanner scope, nested-condition counting, delimiter stopping, and skip-line tracking.
Defines push, pop, and identity-specific limit changes across recursive conditional evaluation.
Defines true/false branch selection and the nested-frame-sensitive false-limb skip.
Dispatches every TeX82 comparison family to its canonical operand scanner or state query.
Tracing-only display of an already computed boolean; it adds no independent conditional transition.
Defines integer/dimension relations and recovery, oddness, and box-register predicates.
Defines expanded character/category comparison and raw meaning/token-list comparison for ifx.
Defines ifcase limb selection and legal, premature, and extra delimiter handling through fi.
Reports and unwinds every condition frame still incomplete at final cleanup.

properties.claim: The seventeen TeX82 predicates share the expandable if_test command with operands 0 through 16, while fi, else, and or share fi_or_else operands 2, 3, and 4; recovery uses the frozen fi meaning rather than a redefinable control sequence.
preconditions: The exact eight-bit TeX82 primitive profile has been initialized.
No extension-only predicate or delimiter is admitted to the TeX82 classification.
stimulus: Resolve and deliver every TeX82 predicate and delimiter primitive, including a redefinition of the public fi control sequence before incomplete-skip recovery.
expected_observations: Canonical command observations use if_test operands 0–16 and fi_or_else operands fi=2, else=3, and or=4.
Inserted recovery fi retains the inaccessible frozen primitive identity.
postconditions: Classification alone neither pushes nor pops a condition frame.
Primitive aliases preserve the same command and operand identity.
equivalence_cases: Existing exact tests tex82_conditionals_use_shared_if_test_identity and tex82_conditional_delimiters_use_shared_fi_or_else_identity cover all public primitive identities.
Phase 2 adds conditionals::tests::tex82_predicates_and_delimiters_classify_and_dispatch_from_aliases plus a scanner-conditionals recovery case with a redefined public fi.
recovery_cases: An inserted frozen fi is unaffected by a live fi redefinition.
A delimiter delivered with no live condition is classified normally before extra-delimiter recovery.

properties.claim: Expanded delivery invokes the conditional evaluator for if_test and the delimiter terminator for fi_or_else, recursively completing the selected branch without leaking either command as unexpandable output.
preconditions: Canonical expanded delivery has resolved a predicate or delimiter meaning.
The independent condition stack contains exactly the frames established by prior expanded delivery.
stimulus: Request expanded tokens through nested predicates, accepted delimiters, premature delimiters, and delimiters in skipped text.
expected_observations: Predicate delivery enters conditional evaluation and emits stack/branch observations before expanded delivery resumes.
Delimiter delivery validates the live frame limit, skips when required, and never escapes as an ordinary expanded token.
postconditions: Expanded delivery resumes at the first token in the selected live branch.
Recursive expansion changes only the frame identified by the predicate that initiated it.
equivalence_cases: Direct primitive tokens and control-sequence aliases use the same dispatch.
Phase 2 adds conditionals::tests::expanded_dispatch_consumes_all_if_test_and_fi_or_else_commands and a semantic-matrix row proving no expanded delimiter leakage.
recovery_cases: A premature delimiter replays the inserted relax before operand scanning continues.
An extra delimiter is diagnosed and ignored at its raw-delivery boundary.

properties.claim: Conditions form a stack independent of input and save stacks; push preserves the prior limit, kind, and source line, pop restores them, and limit changes target the initiating frame even when recursive operand expansion has pushed newer frames.
preconditions: The condition stack is empty or contains a well-formed outer frame.
The current source line is known at predicate entry.
stimulus: Enter, complete, and pop nested conditions, including an outer operand whose expansion evaluates and closes an inner condition.
expected_observations: Each predicate pushes an evaluating frame with its kind and source line.
True completion changes that exact frame to else; false completion changes it to fi or pops it; fi restores the prior frame.
postconditions: Popping the last frame restores the empty-stack normal limit and zero current condition state.
Input-level pushes/pops and grouping do not own or reorder condition frames.
equivalence_cases: Nested source, macro, and token-list inputs share one independent condition stack.
Existing condition_identity_updates_outer_frame_after_nested_push covers stable identity; Phase 2 adds conditionals::tests::stack_preserves_lines_limits_and_independence_across_all_pop_paths.
recovery_cases: Recursive evaluation may temporarily place a newer frame above the saved frame without retargeting its limit change.
Final cleanup reports source lines from top to bottom before freeing incomplete frames.

properties.claim: pass_text temporarily sets scanner status to skipping, reads only raw commands, balances nested if_test/fi pairs, ignores braces as structure, and stops at the first outer or, else, or fi while preserving the found delimiter for its caller.
preconditions: A live condition has selected a limb that must be skipped.
The prior scanner status and the starting source line are available.
stimulus: Skip text containing expandable macros, braces, nested conditions, inner delimiters, outer control sequences, and an EOF boundary.
expected_observations: Skipped expandable tokens are delivered raw and not expanded, while nested predicates increment and nested fi decrements the local depth.
Scanner status changes to skipping and is restored exactly once around each pass_text invocation.
postconditions: The cursor is immediately after the stopping delimiter and no skipped branch effect has executed.
The independent condition stack is changed only by the caller or by nested-fi cleanup required by §500.
equivalence_cases: Literal and control-sequence braces have no grouping effect while skipped.

Existing pass_text_uses_get_next_and_skips_nested_conditionals covers raw nesting; Phase 2 adds conditionals::tests::pass_text_does_not_expand_or_execute_skipped_tokens and scanner-conditionals skipped-side-effect markers.
recovery_cases: An outer token during skipping is backed up and recovery inserts frozen fi.
EOF during skipping reports the skip start line before inserted-fi replay.

properties.claim: Boolean and ifcase selection use one nesting-aware skip machine: true booleans wait for else or fi, false booleans find their own else/fi, ifcase skips exactly the requested limbs, and accepted or/else skip through the matching fi before popping.
preconditions: A predicate frame was pushed with evaluating limit before any operands were scanned.
Delimiter legality is compared against the live frame's canonical limit ordering.
stimulus: Evaluate true and false booleans; zero, positive, exhausted, and negative ifcase indices; nested conditions during evaluation and skipping; and every delimiter at evaluating, else, or, fi, and empty-stack limits.
expected_observations: False limbs record each stopped delimiter while still evaluating, then common_ending pops on fi or changes the frame to fi on else.
ifcase records each skipped or under evaluating, changes to or only for a selected case, and negative indices continue until else or fi.
Accepted or and else skip remaining limbs without changing the frame limit; fi pops immediately.
postconditions: Exactly one branch is selected and only its effects execute.
After the matching fi, the prior condition frame and limit are restored.
equivalence_cases: Zero ifcase selects the first limb without pass_text; positive indices select the corresponding or-delimited limb.

Existing focused tests cover selected/exhausted positive cases; Phase 2 adds conditionals::tests::ifcase_zero_negative_else_and_fi_boundaries and scanner-conditionals transcript markers for every case boundary.
recovery_cases: An or encountered while seeking a false boolean's else/fi is diagnosed as extra and skipping continues.
A delimiter above an evaluating limit inserts relax; above any completed limit it emits the matching Extra diagnostic and is ignored.

properties.claim: TeX82 evaluates integer and dimension relations, oddness, mode/inner state, box kind/voidness, stream EOF state, and constant true/false predicates through their canonical scanners and executor-owned state without changing the tested values.
preconditions: Typed integer, normal-dimension, register, box, mode, and read-stream queries expose canonical current state.
Predicate operands are scanned after the evaluating frame has been pushed.
stimulus: Exercise less/equal/greater integer and dimension comparisons, odd positive/zero/negative integers, every outer/inner mode family, void/hbox/vbox registers, open/closed streams, and true/false constants.
expected_observations: ifnum and ifdim consume two typed operands and one relation; ifodd uses Pascal odd semantics.
Mode predicates use absolute mode, ifinner uses negative mode, box predicates distinguish null/hlist/vlist, and ifeof tests the scanned four-bit stream.
postconditions: Predicate reads do not mutate registers, boxes, mode, or stream-open state.
The selected boolean is handed to the common branch machine.
equivalence_cases: Literal, signed-radix, register, parameter, and internal values with equal canonical values compare identically.

Existing tests cover representative numeric, dimension, mode, box, and stream cases; Phase 2 adds conditionals::tests::all_scalar_and_state_predicate_truth_tables and scanner-conditionals reference-visible truth-table markers.
recovery_cases: A missing relation reports Missing = inserted, backs up the nonrelation token, and compares for equality.
An out-of-range stream or box number follows its canonical scanner recovery before the predicate query.

properties.claim: if and ifcat expand operands and compare normalized character code or category, including noexpand-active handling, while ifx reads both operands raw and compares nonmacro meanings or macro flags plus complete parameter/replacement token texts.
preconditions: Current meanings and immutable macro token texts are available without using allocation identity as semantics.
The scanner status can be temporarily normalized while ifx reads outer meanings.
stimulus: Compare characters, category variants, active characters after noexpand, noncharacter controls, equal/different primitive meanings, and macros varying flags, parameter text, replacement text, and storage identity.
expected_observations: if compares character codes and ifcat compares categories after expanded delivery; noncharacters use the common relax/256 sentinel.
ifx does not expand operands, admits outer controls, and treats macros as equal exactly when command flags and raw token sequences match.
postconditions: Exactly two operands are consumed and the prior scanner status is restored.
Macro reference/storage identity has no effect on ifx equality.
equivalence_cases: Distinct macro allocations containing identical flags and tokens compare equal; expanded definitions with different stored tokens compare unequal.

Existing tests cover normalization, raw delivery, flags, and noexpand-active behavior; Phase 2 adds conditionals::tests::if_ifcat_and_ifx_complete_operand_matrix and matching scanner-conditionals markers.
recovery_cases: A delimiter encountered while either operand is being obtained follows evaluating-limit inserted-relax recovery.
A noncharacter operand to if/ifcat is normalized rather than diagnosed.

properties.claim: EOF or an outer token during conditional skipping emits the canonical incomplete-if diagnostic and inserts frozen fi before parent input resumes; end/dump separately reports and unwinds every still-open condition with its kind and source line.
preconditions: Scanner status is skipping with a live current condition, or final cleanup begins with one or more live condition frames.
The skip start line and each condition's entry line have been retained.
stimulus: Exhaust a child file and the terminal source while pass_text is active, encounter an outer control during skipping, and invoke final cleanup with nested incomplete conditions.
expected_observations: Outer-validity recovery identifies the current condition, reports the skip start line, distinguishes EOF wording, and inserts inaccessible frozen fi.
Final cleanup reports incomplete frames from innermost to outermost with nonzero source lines and frees the entire stack.
postconditions: Inserted-fi replay permits ordinary conditional completion without redefinable-token dependence.
After final cleanup no condition node remains live.
equivalence_cases: Physical-file and token-list exhaustion use the same skipping recovery ordering at their canonical input boundaries.

The committed scanner-conditionals-eof minifixture covers one child EOF; Phase 2 adds conditionals::tests::skipping_eof_outer_and_final_cleanup_recovery_order plus nested EOF/final-cleanup semantic cases.
recovery_cases: An outer token is backed up for rereading after inserted-fi recovery; EOF has no token to back up.
Multiple incomplete conditions at final cleanup each produce one ordered report rather than one collapsed diagnostic.
